name: homePos
meaning: spawn position: Init after the ground snap, msg 9 arg 1 (container release); Reset returns here when IN_WORLD

name: sound
meaning: handle of the whirr: 0x6b one-shot start, then 0x6c loop (Fan_UpdateSound); stopped by Fan_StopSound

name: lastReport
meaning: FanReport: classId = class id of the nearest attracted object relayed by msg 0x34 (the Perfume forwards the sheep's report, class 0xB); 0 = none. Low word of the u32 report returned by msg 6; proximity = dist*0xffff/range of that report (smaller = closer); a new report replaces it when <= stored or when the stored one is >= 0x800 ticks old

name: reportTime
meaning: g_gameTime of the last stored report; msg 6 answers only while g_gameTime - reportTime <= 0x800 (0.5 s)

name: state
meaning: FanState, also the index into g_fanStateAnims 0x576010

name: soundStarted
meaning: 0 = the next Fan_UpdateSound plays the start whirr 0x6b; 1 = the start was played, keep the 0x6c loop going. Cleared by Fan_StopSound, Reset and Init

name: pad8e
meaning: tail padding to sizeof 0x90; never accessed
